facts.fact: 本节开场即 Dal Mare 的内心：即使找到 Peter 他也没打算留 Giada 活口
facts.anchor: Even if he finds Peter, Hook does not intend to leave the young chit alive

facts.fact: Dal Mare 认为杀掉发烧的 Michele 是浪费：这孩子的性情令他起兴趣
facts.anchor: Killing him would be a terrible waste

facts.fact: Dal Mare 下令撬开 Giada 家门的门锁
facts.anchor: “Open it,” orders Captain Hook

facts.fact: 门内正是要出门的 Wendy 与 Peter，双方迎头撞上
facts.anchor: On the other side, just about to open the door, there’s the Wondrous Wendy. Beside her, Peter

facts.fact: 楼下 Giada 求看守她的少年海盗 Noose 联系头目
facts.anchor: “Can you call your boss?” she asks the pirate

facts.fact: Wendy 不动声色把 Peter 挡到身后
facts.anchor: Angela gently pushes the satyr behind her

facts.fact: Wendy 认出打手之一出现在她反复做过的飞岛梦里
facts.anchor: That dream she had a couple of times, where she was flying towards an island with a galleon at anchor

facts.fact: 梦里的岛当场渗透进客厅，海水舔她的鞋，幻景仍怯于自认真实
facts.anchor: the island from her dream pushes through, and the water laps at her shoes, but still hazily, as if the vision is too shy to claim to be real

facts.fact: Wendy 问「你是什么」，Dal Mare 答：一个教书的
facts.anchor: “A teacher,” he replies

facts.fact: 倒数到六十后 Noose 先言语羞辱再扇 Giada 第一记耳光
facts.anchor: Noose licks his lips. “You’re a hot bitch,” he says

facts.fact: 施暴中 Giada 的视线里 Noose 瞬时穿成埃罗尔·弗林的海盗装
facts.anchor: And Noose is on her, and while he throws himself at her, for an instant it’s like he’s dressed like Errol Flynn

facts.fact: 叙述者以判句确认：这个至少小她十岁的男孩正在强奸她
facts.anchor: This boy, who is at least ten years younger than her, is raping her. That is all there is to say

facts.fact: 转折句：Giada 没有碎，她完整的是愤怒
facts.anchor: She is not broken, she is very much herself; and what she is, is angry

facts.fact: 喘息间隙 Giada 手腕一转夺刀刺向 Noose
facts.anchor: Giada seizes the knife, points it at him with a movement of the wrist

facts.fact: Wendy 浑身淤伤血迹却不落一泪瘫在地板上
facts.anchor: Covered in bruises and blood, but without having shed a single tear, Angela is sprawled on the floor

facts.fact: 她临死前的判断：这群凶手就是 Wonder 本身
facts.anchor: These pirates, these horrible killers led by Augusto Dal Mare, are Wonder, even if they don’t know it

facts.fact: Wendy 承认空帽里再次出兔——魔法在她眼前实证
facts.anchor: Once again a rabbit has come out of an empty hat

facts.fact: Peter 放出的绿光同时是音乐，每道光成一个音、每个音成一次爱抚
facts.anchor: Green, blinding light. A light that is music at the same time, each ray becoming a note, each note becoming a caress

facts.fact: 赤脚女孩们破窗而入（五层楼进来六个人）
facts.anchor: The window shatters

facts.fact: 认出为首赤脚女孩正是 ch09 Pineto 公园那位无鞋少女
facts.anchor: she’s the one I saw at the Pineto, thinks Wendy

facts.fact: 赤脚女孩（Tinker Bell）向 Dal Mare 横刀相对
facts.anchor: She levels a delicate blade at Augusto

facts.fact: 街上的 Giovanni 听见漫天水声被一支长笛整成旋律
facts.anchor: as the noise grows and the note of a flute gives it the hint of a command, the note of a flute makes noise into melody

facts.fact: Giovanni 此刻领悟：导师错了，岛存在，是真实的传说
facts.anchor: Fatty Bolger was wrong. The Island exists

facts.fact: 他的答案不在故纸堆而在四周——学术线在此转向
facts.anchor: It’s not in old papers that he has found his story: it’s all around him

facts.fact: Hook 收剑的理由：撤退不光荣，蠢死更无光荣可言
facts.anchor: there is no honour in a stupid death either

facts.fact: Peter 下令不得追击，Hook 恨这份可敬的荣誉感
facts.anchor: No one will follow him, no one will attack him, those are Peter’s orders

facts.fact: Hook 推断 Noose 违令强奸，扬言让他求生不得求死不能
facts.anchor: That dunce Noose must have raped the girl

facts.fact: 原文写 Hook 对 Peter 荣誉感的又一层恨意
facts.anchor: It’s one more reason to hate him: that boy has an insufferable sense of honour

facts.fact: Michele 从旧漫画知道萨满职责含治愈，手头却只有想象力作医疗
facts.anchor: Michele knows (he read it in an old issue of Alpha Flight) that the duties of the shaman include healing

facts.fact: Giada 对赶来的 Michele 说自己杀了人
facts.anchor: “I killed him,” Giada answers

facts.fact: Michele 用「另一种看法」看见楼下三人在城里衣着下实为海盗
facts.anchor: seen like that, those three are pirates

facts.fact: 母城灵体如舞会般交配成网，齐声召唤它们的萨满
facts.anchor: Asphalt joins in swift couplings with Car and Scooter, Traffic dances through their unions

facts.fact: 沥青回答 Michele：他回来了，战争开始
facts.anchor: He’s come back, responds Asphalt. The war begins

facts.fact: 事后 Wendy 摸脸发现伤还在疼，但她毫不在意
facts.anchor: Wendy touches her face, almost expecting the wounds to be healed, but they’re all there, and they still hurt

facts.fact: 光凝成少年：像 Peter 又全然是人
facts.anchor: In place of the faun there’s a youth

facts.fact: 章末仙童自报家门并宣布派对时刻
facts.anchor: “Peter Pan, babe.” The boy puts his hands on his waist. “And it’s time to party.”
